description: Read one bounded part of one run event by run id and seq, typically claudexor_run_wait's oversizedEvent. Returns the exact UTF-8 bytes [offset, nextOffset) of the redacted serialization the run event stream delivers, with totalBytes and the sha256 of the whole event; parts never split a character. Read from offset 0, then each nextOffset until it equals totalBytes; a partial read is not a consumed event, so do not move claudexor_run_wait past it until the last part. Only validated events of this run are readable; there is no path, artifact or whole-log access.

maxBytes.description: Upper bound of this part's UTF-8 bytes; a part may end earlier at a character boundary.

seq.description: The event to read, e.g. claudexor_run_wait's oversizedEvent.seq.

name: claudexor_run_event_read

outputSchema.description: One bounded part of a single validated run event, read from the run's own event log by run id and seq. Concatenate parts in offset order until nextOffset equals totalBytes; only then is the event consumed.

nextOffset.description: Where the next part starts; equal to totalBytes when this part ends the event.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset where this part starts.

seq.description: Durable seq of the event (its event-stream id).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of all totalBytes; verify the reassembled text before parsing it.

text.description: Bytes [offset, nextOffset) decoded as UTF-8; a boundary never splits a character.

totalBytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the event's complete stream serialization: the redacted JSON line the run event stream delivers.

type.description: Type of an append-only run event, covering run lifecycle, contract/context creation, budget, routing fallbacks, harness activity, interactions, gates, review, arbitration, work products, and control verbs.
